_comment: TDD M4 reasoning slice 1, loss partition (lossy): effort outside the known enum values is dropped with a loss report; the loss header is present and no reasoning.effort reaches the upstream. GREEN on baseline and must stay GREEN after impl.
name: m4_reasoning_chat_responses_enum_mismatch_lossy
config:
[server]
auth_mode = "none"
allow_dynamic_routes = false

[retry]
max_attempts = 1

[providers.resplossy]
dialect = "openai-responses"
base_url = "{UPSTREAM}/v1"
api_key = "resp-secret"
compatibility = "lossy"

[[models]]
name = "bridge-lossy"
provider = "resplossy"
model = "gpt-4.1"

[capabilities.overrides."bridge-lossy".reasoning.effort]
supported = true
values = ["low", "medium"]
